comment: High-severity advisories with no patched release upstream, accepted until one ships. Each entry must name the advisory, why it is accepted, and where it comes from. scripts/audit-check.mjs fails when an entry no longer matches an advisory, so the list shrinks by itself.

advisories.reason: Stack exhaustion on deeply nested glob patterns. No patched release (3.0.3 is the latest and is affected). Reached only through dev tooling (jest, ts-node-dev, chokidar) that globs our own files, never user input.

RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification flaw. No patched release (1.4.0 is the latest and is affected). Reached only through @expo/cli code signing in the Expo build tooling, which verifies nothing at runtime in the app or the API.
